name: Vol-contraction dip-buy — realized calming into a washout (4h)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM: the realized-vol-only calm-reversion — buy a washed-out dip ONLY once realized volatility has already CONTRACTED, so we are catching a knife that has stopped falling rather than mid-panic. Volatility clusters and mean-reverts (GARCH); a high-vol flush that then calms (vol_realized dropping below a fitted ceiling) marks the point where the forced-seller flow has exhausted and the tape can drift back up. This is distinct from a plain oversold dip-buy because the vol-CONTRACTION gate is the timing edge: it keeps us OUT of the still-accelerating leg of a sell-off (the knife) and only fires once realized has cooled. Entry (long): vol_realized below a fitted ceiling (realized has calmed) AND rsi in washout (price is oversold) AND range_position near the bottom of its band (at the low, genuine washout not mid-range). The counterparty is the panic seller who dumped into the flush; we buy once their flow is spent. Realized features only (no DVOL) -> dodges the 148-point data wall. Exit: rsi crosses up out of oversold (the bounce has paid) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if the plain RSI washout dip-buy (drop the vol_realized-contraction gate) matches the deflated Sharpe, the vol-contraction timing adds nothing and this is generic oversold. DISCONFIRMER 2: if range_position and rsi co-fire >80% of the time they are one over-extension gauge -> drop one. DISCONFIRMER 3: net of ~20bps round-trip at 4h the bounces must clear per-trade.
catalyst: a washed-out dip AFTER realized vol has already contracted — the knife has stopped
